from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationData(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper and the other provided papers it references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper as extracted from the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers referenced in this paper's bibliography; must match titles extracted from the document collection")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationData]
